run_wut_list_abstractions: run the mephisto wut command with no args to list all valid abstractions and descriptions
run_wut_query_blueprint_args: run the mephisto wut command with blueprint=<type> to display configuration arguments for a blueprint
run_wut_query_architect_args: run the mephisto wut command with architect=<type> to display configuration arguments for an architect
run_wut_query_provider_args: run the mephisto wut command with provider=<type> to display configuration arguments for a crowd provider
run_wut_query_task_args: run the mephisto wut command with task to display configuration arguments for the TaskRun class
